title: 安洵杯 2020 (web: 原型链污染 Welcome)
description: Nodejs web. express-validator 6.6.0 depends on lodash < 4.17.17, which is vulnerable to prototype pollution (CVE-style). By polluting the prototype (e.g. value/options) the sanitizer/filter logic is bypassed to achieve RCE / read the flag. Reconstructed from 安洵杯官方wp (local PDF). Flag from official writeup.
